select '1' id,'vic' name, '2024-04-01' filename_date into d360.test_dedup
insert into d360.test_dedup
select '1' id,'vic' name, '2024-04-06' filename_date 

truncate table d360.test_dedup
select * from d360.test_dedup

delete from d360.test_dedup where filename_Date='2024-04-05'
select * from d360.test_dedup order by id, filename_Date, name
select '1' id,'v' name, '2024-04-02' filename_date 
select *, lead(name) over (partition by id order by filename_date) from d360.test_dedup order by filename_Date

	select  
		id, 
		name, 
		filename_date, 
		(case when COALESCE(lead(name) over (partition by id  order by filename_date),'0')<>name then filename_date  else null end) end_dt
	from 
		d360.test_dedup
		order by 
		id,filename_date





select 
distinct
id, 
name,
min(filename_date) strt_dt,
(case when rnk=1 then null else max(filename_date) end) end_dt
from 
(

	select 
	id, 
	name,
	filename_date,
    end_dt,
	COALESCE(end_dt,FIRST_VALUE(end_dt) over (partition by id,name order by end_dt)) lv,
	case when (rank() over (partition by id order by filename_date desc)) = 1 then 1 else 0  end rnk
	from 
	(
		select  
			id, 
			name, 
			filename_date, 
			(case when COALESCE(lead(name) over (partition by id  order by filename_date),'0')<>name then filename_date  else null end) end_dt
		from 
			d360.test_dedup
	
	) a 
	order by 
	id,filename_date
) b 
group by
id, 
name,
lv,
rnk
order by 
id,strt_dt
